pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #54134, ref #53246

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?
- fill correct involved schemainfo for 'flashback table' and 'flashback schema'. this issue is not exposed as before this pr, general DDL only have 1 worker, so the second flashback cannot be run, but after https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/54041, general DDL can be run in parallel

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)

existing `TestParallelFlashbackTable` should cover the case, so will not add new one. by add some sleep to make sure those 2 sql run in parallel, the case will fail before this pr, but ok after

- [ ] No need to test
  > - [ ] I checked and no code files have been changed.
  > <!-- Or your custom  "No need to test" reasons -->
